name: db
comment: Both client libraries are OPTIONAL, and they are one group because a lib.json carries one optional_* set. Without them the library still builds and every command fails at run time with KN_ERR_UNSUPPORTED naming what to install, rather than failing the build of everyone who never opens a database. When the manifest grows a second optional group, split sqlite3 from the MySQL client so a machine with one and not the other gets the one. The probe is pkg-config, not a header path: a header proves a header, and GitHub's runner image carries libmysqlclient's headers with no library to match, which turned this group on and then failed to link.
